+---
+Delete the MCP `shell` tool and all its registration.
+
+Work:
+- Delete `crates/swissarmyhammer-tools/src/mcp/tools/shell/` (execute_command, grep_history, get_lines, list_processes, kill_process, state, process, infrastructure, test_helpers, description.md).
+- Remove `register_shell_tools`, the `"shell"` entry in `tool_config.rs:38`, and shell uses in `tool_registry.rs`, `server/mod.rs`, `server/profiles.rs`, `health_registry.rs`, `lib.rs`, `mcp/mod.rs`, `kanban/mod.rs`.
+- Remove shell uses in `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/src/mcp_integration.rs` and `tests/integration/mcp_tools_registration.rs`.

+- Remove the `swissarmyhammer-shell` dependency from `swissarmyhammer-tools/Cargo.toml`.
+
+Depends on the Bash deny card.
+Done when: `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo test -p swissarmyhammer-tools` pass, and no `shell` tool appears in the tool list.
\ No newline at end of file
